objective:
`parse-duration.mjs` exports a default `parseDuration(input)` that converts
duration strings into total seconds and satisfies all eight acceptance criteria.

hard: Plain Node ESM, zero dependencies, single file.
No CLI, no formatting helpers, no test files required of the worker.

acceptance_criteria: AC4: whitespace is tolerated — parseDuration(' 1h 30m ') returns 5400.
AC5: units are case-insensitive — parseDuration('1H30M') returns 5400.
AC6: fractional values work — parseDuration('1.5h') returns 5400.
AC7: invalid input (empty string, non-string, unparseable text) throws TypeError.
